claims.text: Among all prevalent atrial fibrillation patients, 2,929 (2.14%) developed serious bleeding, while 134,161 (97.86%) did not [^src1]
Among patients receiving DOAC anticoagulation, 2,349 (2.30%) developed serious bleeding compared to 99,866 (97.70%) who did not [^src1]
Among patients receiving Marevan, 154 (2.38%) developed serious bleeding compared to 6,321 (97.62%) who did not [^src1]
Among patients receiving both DOAC and Marevan, 69 (6.45%) developed serious bleeding compared to 1,000 (93.55%) who did not [^src1]
Among patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, 357 (1.31%) developed serious bleeding compared to 26,974 (98.69%) who did not [^src1]

For Indicator 11 (serious bleeding in newly diagnosed patients), Denmark overall showed 691 / 21,804 patients (3.2%, 95% CI 2.9-3.4) developing serious bleeding in the period 01.07.2022 - 30.06.2023 [^src1]

timeline.event: Measurement period for Indicator 11 (serious bleeding in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients) and Indicator 15 (heart failure in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients)

context: Denne dokumentchunk præsenterer detaljerede kvalitetsindikatorer for behandling af atrieflimren i Danmark, med fokus på to vigtige kliniske udfald: alvorlig blødning (Indikator 11) og udvikling af hjertesvigt (Indikator 15) hos nydiagnosticerede patienter inden for et år. Data er stratificeret efter region og sundhedsklynge, hvilket muliggør sammenligning af behandlingskvalitet på tværs af det danske sundhedsvæsen. Disse indikatorer er centrale for at overvåge sikkerheden og effektiviteten af antikoagulationsbehandling hos patienter med atrieflimren.
